Name: Hazor in Arabia
ModernLocation: Unknown; the desert region near Dumat al-Jandal, Saudi Arabia
Description: The kingdoms of Hazor named in Jeremiah's oracle against Kedar and the men of the east, whom Nebuchadnezzar would smite — a desert Hazor of nomad kingdoms, not the city in the north.
BiblicalSignificance: Jeremiah pairs Hazor with Kedar as the settled and nomad east facing Babylon's judgment; its kingdoms and unwalled villages mark it as Arabian, far from Galilee.
